name: Ananya Rao
input_text: 2nd-year PhD in media studies at a public university in Hyderabad. I study how Dalit and Bahujan creators use Instagram and YouTube to build counterpublics, and how platform moderation treats caste speech. Also interested in Partition memory online and South Asian diaspora media. I want to present somewhere good this year and get feedback before I write my chapters. Budget is tight, around 1.5 lakh a trip, and I'd rather avoid long visa queues.
affiliation: Department of Communication, a public university in Hyderabad
